{{Quote|But Old Republic records chronicle the Vultar Cataclysm, an event in which the activation of an artifact known as the Cosmic Turbine destroyed that system.|Edited transcript of the debriefing of Doctor Insmot Bowen|<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref>}}
The '''Vultar system''' was a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vultar]]. It was also the location of the [[Cosmic Turbine]] [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]]-manipulation machine, which was believed to have originally been used by the ancient [[Celestial/Legends|Celestial]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to construct the [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. In [[4250 BBY]], the Vultar system was [[Vultar Cataclysm|destroyed]] after a group of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] activated the Cosmic Turbine in order to use it against their [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] enemies. The [[Mundicide|destruction]] left behind the [[Vultar Nebula]].

==Description==
The Vultar system was a part of the [[Arrowhead]] region in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained several [[Planet/Legends|planets]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> including [[Vultar]].<ref name="CSWE VultarCataclysm" /> A group of massive machines, which included<ref name="GH39">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 39: The Third Great Schism}}</ref> the immense<ref name="GH1">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 01: The Architects}}</ref> [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]]-manipulation device known as the [[Cosmic Turbine]],<ref name="TEA" /> was also located in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="GH39" />

==History==
{{Quote|During the Vultar Cataclysm in the Third Great Schism, dark siders influenced by the Sith triggered the obliteration of an entire world.|Chief Librarian Restelly Quist, ''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force''|<ref name="JP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>}}
[[File:Vultar25200BBY-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Vultar system was believed to have been created by the Celestials.]]
Evidence pointed to the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]],<ref name="GH39" /> an advanced [[Species/Legends|species]] that disappeared from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in [[30,000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> having used the Cosmic Turbine<ref name="CSWE CosmicTurbine">{{CSWECite|I|148|Cosmic Turbine}}</ref> and the other devices to construct the Vultar system,<ref name="GH39" /> including its planets.<ref name="NEC" /> It was believed that the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]], a species transplanted by the Celestials off the former's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], witnessed the creation of the Vultar system.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

During the [[Third Great Schism]]<ref name="GH39" /> of [[4250 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> a group of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] took up residence in the Vultar system. There, the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] adherents discovered the Celestial machines and activated them in order to use them against their enemy, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The [[darksider]]s proved to be unable to control the devices, however, leading to a catastrophic accident<ref name="GH39" /> known as the [[Vultar Cataclysm]]<ref name="NEC" /> that [[Mundicide|destroyed]] the entire Vultar system, including the machines and the Dark Jedi.<ref name="GH39" /> The catastrophe left behind the [[Vultar Nebula]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

The destruction of the Vultar system came to be chronicled in [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] records.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> A section of<ref name="JP" /> the [[990 BBY]]<ref name="990 BBY">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2010/12/endnotes-for-star-wars-jedi-path-part-1.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Jedi Path (part 1 of 4)|quote=Okay, so we've established that this particular copy of the [[Book/Legends|book]] dates from [[115 BBY]]. But the content inside is [&hellip;] dating from the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[990 BBY]].}}</ref> [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainee]] [[Book/Legends|guidebook]] ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'' [[Author/Legends|authored]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Chief Librarian/Legends|Chief Librarian]] [[Restelly Quist/Legends|Restelly Quist]] described the Vultar Cataclysm as having led to "the obliteration of an entire world,"<ref name="JP" /> and the [[Star/Legends|star]] system's fate was also mentioned in the [[Jedi historian]] [[Tionne Solusar]]'s publication ''[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force]]'', published in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the [[Obroan Institute for Archaeology]] researcher [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Insmot Bowen]] also noted the destruction of the Vultar system during a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] debriefing on the Celestials.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vultar system was first mentioned in the [[2005]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Kevin J. Anderson]].<ref name="NEC" /> In [[2009]], the reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square L-10.<ref name="TEA" />

The star system was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned the system was cut before the book's release. The information regarding the Cosmic Turbine was later released in [[2013]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and [[Del Rey]] editor [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" />
